messages.author: Wren Haviland
messages.text: Thursday on the core lane is embargoed like every weekday, and Dario has Thursday's secondary blocks without the identity runbook cert. LANE-DATA is free Thursday but it is not certified for tier-1.

messages.author: Tunde Abara
messages.text: The audit evidence freeze holds the core lane on the 18th and 19th. Nobody has asked me for an exception.

messages.author: Saoirse Lindgren
messages.text: Budget is fine: 9 charged of 43. INC-70869 is reclassified. The console change on Thursday is a different CI and lane — do not confuse the two.
